HediffDef.label: nightwatcher's boon
HediffDef.description: The Nightwatcher granted {PAWN_nameDef} a boon. It is permanent now, woven into {PAWN_possessive} Spiritweb like thread into cloth. It cannot be separated from who {PAWN_pronoun} is.

HediffDef.label: nightwatcher's curse
HediffDef.description: The Nightwatcher laid a curse on {PAWN_nameDef}. It settled into {PAWN_possessive} Spiritweb like a splinter beneath the skin. No ordinary means will remove it.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: stormlight affinity
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s Spiritweb hums in time with the storms. {PAWN_pronoun} can hold far more Stormlight than before, and {PAWN_possessive} hands move with a delicate precision that wasn't there yesterday.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: sharpened mind
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s mind is clearer now. Thoughts arrive sharp and fast, and research that once frustrated {PAWN_nameDef} flows like water downhill.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: voice of cultivation
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} speaks and others listen. The words carry a warmth, a weight, that they did not have before. People find themselves agreeing before they realize they've been persuaded.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: awakened mind
HediffDef.description: The Nightwatcher broke something open in {PAWN_nameDef}'s mind. Patterns emerge where there were none before. Research comes faster, and {PAWN_possessive} hands work with a surgeon's instinct during operations.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: always warm
HediffDef.description: The cold does not touch {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_pronoun} walks through freezing wind and feels nothing but comfort. An odd blessing, but a real one.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: slowed clock
HediffDef.description: Time has stopped for {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_possessive} body holds at its current age, no longer declining, no longer wearing down. {PAWN_pronoun} rests more efficiently, shakes off sickness faster, and will not grow old. Cultivation's most patient gift.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: lifelight
HediffDef.description: Cultivation rewrote {PAWN_nameDef}'s Spiritweb at its foundation. Food becomes Investiture directly, light pooling steadily beneath the skin. {PAWN_possessive} body heals faster, fights disease harder, and sustains itself with an efficiency that is not natural.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: old pain
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} feels an ache now, deep and constant. It was not there before the Nightwatcher. It will not leave.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: weighted steps
HediffDef.description: Every step {PAWN_nameDef} takes is heavier than it should be. Not pain, exactly. Just weight. As if the ground itself is reluctant to let {PAWN_nameDef} go.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: sleepless dread
HediffDef.description: Sleep does not come easily to {PAWN_nameDef} anymore. Something stirs in the dark hours, something {PAWN_pronoun} cannot name. Rest is never enough.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: grey world
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} can still name colors. Can still point to red, to blue. But they look wrong now. Muted. Drained of something essential. The world is quieter than it used to be.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: glass bones
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s bones are fragile now. They look the same, feel the same, until something hits. A blow others would shrug off can break {PAWN_nameDef}.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: watcher's shadow
HediffDef.description: Something watches {PAWN_nameDef}. Always. At the edge of vision, in the silence between sounds. It never speaks. It never leaves. {PAWN_pronoun} has learned to live with the feeling, but {PAWN_pronoun} has never gotten used to it.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: verdant sensitivity
HediffDef.description: Plant-based food sits wrong in {PAWN_nameDef}'s stomach. Not dangerous, but deeply uncomfortable. The Nightwatcher has an odd sense of what constitutes a minor inconvenience.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: silenced
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s voice still works. The sounds come out. But the meaning does not carry. Words fall flat, stripped of weight and intent. People hear {PAWN_nameDef} speak and somehow do not listen.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: cultivated endurance
HediffDef.description: Years of carrying invisible weight have changed {PAWN_nameDef}. The curse did not break. It bent, then hardened into something useful. {PAWN_pronoun} works with an efficiency born from years of struggling against resistance.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: protected by the watcher
HediffDef.description: The watcher is still there. {PAWN_nameDef} can feel it. But after years, the presence has shifted. It no longer unsettles. It guards. Cultivation's eye has turned kind, and {PAWN_nameDef} moves through danger with a strange certainty that something is looking out for {PAWN_nameDef}.

HediffDef.label: Nightwatcher: the silent diplomat
HediffDef.description: Cultivation's lesson took years, but it is finished. Silence taught {PAWN_nameDef} what no voice ever could. {PAWN_pronoun} reads people now, understands them without needing to speak. Trade flows easily. Negotiation is natural. The silence became a gift.

HediffDef.label: sudden collapse
HediffDef.description: Darkness took {PAWN_nameDef} without warning. One moment {PAWN_pronoun} was standing. The next, nothing.
